source.label: mtgtop8, Eternal Weekend 2017 Vintage European Championship

notes.text: Run by Magic Bazar / Bazaar of Moxen; no source found names the city or venue (probably the Paris area). Placings and seeds are from the organizer's coverage, archived, and its Challonge bracket: quarterfinals Solís (1) def. Martens (8) 2-0, Rodriguez Pozo (5) def. Gonzalez Caballero (4) 2-0, Fougerouse (7) def. Matesanz Garcia (2) 2-0, Crespo (3) def. Mode (6) 2-0; semifinals Solís def. Rodriguez Pozo 2-0, Crespo def. Fougerouse 2-1; final Solís def. Crespo 2-1. They agree with mtgtop8's, which the lists are copied from.
The bracket, as embedded on the organizer's page.
MTGGoldfish has the same Top 8 in an exact 1st-8th order that differs from mtgtop8's, but two of its lists have impossible counts (56-card main deck, 14-card sideboard), so it was not used.
The winner's deck is "Eldrazi Aggro" on mtgtop8, "White Eldrazi" on the organizer's page and "Displacer Taxes" on MTGGoldfish.
Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events. Kept from the earlier source where Goldfish names only colours or lists no deck: Sergio Matesanz Garcia (not on Goldfish).
mtgtop8's page has the name with broken accents ("Joaqu­n Sol­s").
